gloss: to train; to prepare; to stock up

definitions.explanation: To thoroughly train someone in a skill, trade, or discipline.
To prepare ingredients or ferment products like sake, miso, or soy sauce.

definitions.gloss: to stock up; to lay in
definitions.explanation: To purchase and store goods for future sale or use.

examples.japanese: {師匠|ししょう}に{芸|げい}を{仕込|しこ}まれた。
examples.english: I was trained in the art by my master.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}に{芸|げい}を{仕込|しこ}むには、{根気|こんき}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Training a dog to do tricks requires patience.

examples.japanese: {味噌|みそ}を{仕込|しこ}むのは{冬|ふゆ}がいい。
examples.english: Winter is the best time to prepare miso.

examples.japanese: {料理人|りょうりにん}は{朝|あさ}{早|はや}くから{仕込|しこ}みを{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: The chef starts food preparation early in the morning.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{商品|しょうひん}を{仕込|しこ}んでおいた。
examples.english: I stocked up on new products.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}に{向|む}けて、{大量|たいりょう}の{在庫|ざいこ}を{仕込|しこ}んだ。
examples.english: I stocked up on a large inventory for the end of the year.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}{商品|しょうひん}を{多|おお}めに{仕込|しこ}んでおいたおかげで、{売|う}り{切|き}れにならなかった。
examples.english: Thanks to stocking up on popular items in large quantities, we didn't run out.

notes:
{仕込|しこ}む is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) with origins in traditional apprenticeship and food preparation. It implies thorough preparation over time.

ASPECT (ている):
{仕込|しこ}んでいる indicates preparation is in progress. For fermentation, {仕込|しこ}んである indicates something has been prepared and is now aging.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [person]に[skill]を{仕込|しこ}む — to train [person] in [skill]
- [product]を{仕込|しこ}む — to prepare/brew [product]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {味噌|みそ}を{仕込|しこ}む (prepare miso)
- {酒|さけ}を{仕込|しこ}む (brew sake)
- {弟子|でし}を{仕込|しこ}む (train an apprentice)
- {商品|しょうひん}を{仕込|しこ}む (stock up on merchandise)

TRADITIONAL CONTEXT:
Originating from traditional crafts and brewing, {仕込|しこ}む implies patient, thorough preparation and often strict discipline in training.

NOUN FORM:
{仕込|しこ}み (preparation, training, stock)

forms.negative: {仕込|しこ}んでいませんでした
